description.en: A new overload InstallAsync(source, scope, IProgress<KazoPackageInstallProgress>?, cancellationToken) reports each KazoPackageInstallStage (Preparing, Downloading with BytesReceived and TotalBytes, Verifying, AwaitingApproval, Installing). The existing overload is unchanged; IAppManagementGateway gets a matching member with a default body. A cref to KazoAppPackages.InstallAsync without parameters is now ambiguous: name the overload.
description.fr: Une nouvelle surcharge InstallAsync(source, scope, IProgress<KazoPackageInstallProgress>?, cancellationToken) rapporte chaque KazoPackageInstallStage (Preparing, Downloading avec BytesReceived et TotalBytes, Verifying, AwaitingApproval, Installing). La surcharge existante ne change pas ; IAppManagementGateway reçoit un membre correspondant avec un corps par défaut. Un cref vers KazoAppPackages.InstallAsync sans paramètres devient ambigu : nommer la surcharge.
